name: Minimum land area vs. location & program count
quote: Land requirement for Engineering & Technology institutions depends on the location class (Rural / Urban / Metro) and the number of programs being applied for.
note: Engine: floor(area_type) + additional_per_5 * max(0, ceil((program_count-5)/5)). Incremental per program bucket of 5.

name: Faculty-student ratio (UG 1:20)
quote: For UG Engineering & Technology programs the faculty-to-student ratio shall be maintained at 1:20.

name: Principal appointment norms
quote: The Principal/Director shall hold a Ph.D. with substantial total experience, including Professor-level service for a minimum period.
note: Engine: Ph.D. required AND total_experience >= 15 AND professor-level >= 5; each failed component is reported separately.

name: Built-up area per student (instructional)
quote: Institutions shall maintain instructional built-up area of at least 10 sqm per sanctioned student.
note: Engine: builtup_area_sqm >= total_intake * 10. Administrative/amenities components deliberately excluded to keep the test single-purpose and explainable.
